mapper.update: MERGE INTO TB_REC_SIGNAL T USING ( SELECT TO_DATE(#{baseDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS BASE_DT, #{stkCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS STK_CD, #{stkNm,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS STK_NM, #{mktCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS MKT_CD, #{curPrice,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AS CUR_PRICE, #{monOpenPrice,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AS MON_OPEN_PRICE, #{ma5,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AS MA5, #{ma20,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AS MA20, #{ma60,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AS MA60, #{ma120,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AS MA120, #{ma240,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AS MA240, #{goldenYn,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS GOLDEN_YN, #{monUpYn,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS MON_UP_YN, #{monChgRate,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AS MON_CHG_RATE, #{trendStrength,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AS TREND_STRENGTH, #{avgTrdVal20,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AS AVG_TRD_VAL_20, #{recYn,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS REC_YN, #{recGrade,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS REC_GRADE, #{recReason,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS REC_REASON FROM DUAL ) S ON (T.BASE_DT = S.BASE_DT AND T.MKT_CD = S.MKT_CD AND T.STK_CD = S.STK_CD) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T.STK_NM = S.STK_NM, T.CUR_PRICE = S.CUR_PRICE, T.MON_OPEN_PRICE = S.MON_OPEN_PRICE, T.MA5 = S.MA5, T.MA20 = S.MA20, T.MA60 = S.MA60, T.MA120 = S.MA120, T.MA240 = S.MA240, T.GOLDEN_YN = S.GOLDEN_YN, T.MON_UP_YN = S.MON_UP_YN, T.MON_CHG_RATE = S.MON_CHG_RATE, T.TREND_STRENGTH = S.TREND_STRENGTH, T.AVG_TRD_VAL_20 = S.AVG_TRD_VAL_20, T.REC_YN = S.REC_YN, T.REC_GRADE = S.REC_GRADE, T.REC_REASON = S.REC_REASON, T.UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( BASE_DT, STK_CD, STK_NM, MKT_CD, CUR_PRICE, MON_OPEN_PRICE, MA5, MA20, MA60, MA120, MA240, GOLDEN_YN, MON_UP_YN, MON_CHG_RATE, TREND_STRENGTH, AVG_TRD_VAL_20, REC_YN, REC_GRADE, REC_REASON, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( S.BASE_DT, S.STK_CD, S.STK_NM, S.MKT_CD, S.CUR_PRICE, S.MON_OPEN_PRICE, S.MA5, S.MA20, S.MA60, S.MA120, S.MA240, S.GOLDEN_YN, S.MON_UP_YN, S.MON_CHG_RATE, S.TREND_STRENGTH, S.AVG_TRD_VAL_20, S.REC_YN, S.REC_GRADE, S.REC_REASON, SYSDATE, SYSDATE )
ALTER TABLE TB_REC_SIGNAL TRUNCATE PARTITION ${partitionName} UPDATE INDEXES

SELECT TO_CHAR(R.BASE_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS baseDt, R.STK_CD AS stkCd, R.STK_NM AS stkNm, R.MKT_CD AS mktCd, M.MKT_CD AS listingMarket, M.INDEX_CD AS indexCd, R.CUR_PRICE AS curPrice, R.MON_OPEN_PRICE AS monOpenPrice, R.MA5 AS ma5, R.MA20 AS ma20, R.MA60 AS ma60, R.MA120 AS ma120, R.MA240 AS ma240, R.GOLDEN_YN AS goldenYn, R.MON_UP_YN AS monUpYn, R.MON_CHG_RATE AS monChgRate, R.TREND_STRENGTH AS trendStrength, R.AVG_TRD_VAL_20 AS avgTrdVal20, R.REC_YN AS recYn, R.REC_GRADE AS recGrade, R.REC_REASON AS recReason FROM TB_REC_SIGNAL R JOIN TB_STK_MASTER M ON M.STK_CD = R.STK_CD WHERE R.BASE_DT = TO_DATE(#{baseDt,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND R.MKT_CD = #{mktCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND M.MKT_CD = 'KOSPI'
AND M.MKT_CD = 'KOSDAQ'
AND M.MKT_CD = 'NASDAQ'
AND M.MKT_CD = 'NYSE'
AND R.MKT_CD = 'US' AND M.INDEX_CD = 'DOW'
AND R.MKT_CD = 'US' AND M.INDEX_CD = 'SNP500'
AND M.INDEX_CD = 'KOSPI200'
AND M.INDEX_CD = 'KOSDAQ150'
AND R.REC_YN = #{recYn,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND R.REC_GRADE = #{recGrade,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND ( UPPER(R.STK_CD) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{searchKeyword,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) || '%' OR UPPER(R.STK_NM) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{searchKeyword,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) || '%' )
ORDER BY R.MON_CHG_RATE DESC, R.TREND_STRENGTH DESC, R.AVG_TRD_VAL_20 DESC, R.STK_CD ASC
